Topics · Hard times

I tried to be good. Why did this happen to me?

The Quran's best people suffered. Pain cannot measure worth, and the account is not settled in this world.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَأْتِكُم مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ خَلَوْا۟ مِن قَبْلِكُم ۖ مَّسَّتْهُمُ ٱلْبَأْسَآءُ وَٱلضَّرَّآءُ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَ ٱلرَّسُولُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ مَتَىٰ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ نَصْرَ ٱللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while such [trial] has not yet come to you as came to those who passed on before you? They were touched by poverty and hardship and were shaken until [even their] messenger and those who believed with him said, "When is the help of Allāh?" Unquestionably, the help of Allāh is near.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:214

Translation

My son, if you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation. Set your heart aright, constantly endure, and don’t make haste in time of calamity. Cling to him, and don’t depart, that you may be increased at your latter end. Accept whatever is brought upon you, and be patient when you suffer humiliation. For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of humiliation. Put your trust in him, and he will help you. Make your ways straight, and set your hope on him.

Original · Ancient Greek

Τεκνὸν εἰ προσέρχῃ δουλεύειν Κυρίῳ Θεῷ, ἑτοίμασον τὴν ψυχήν σου εἰς πειρασμόν. Εὔθυνον τὴν καρδίαν σου καὶ καρτέρησον, καὶ μὴ σπεύσῃς ἐν καιρῷ ἐπαγωγῆς. Κολλήθητι αὐτῷ καὶ μὴ ἀποστῇς, ἵνα αὐξηθῇς ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων σου. Πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν ἐπαχθῇ σοι, δέξαι, καὶ ἐν ἀλλάγμασι ταπεινώσεώς σου μακροθύμησον. Ὅτι ἐν πυρὶ δοκιμάζεται χρυσὸς, καὶ ἄνθρωποι δεκτοὶ ἐν καμίνῳ ταπεινώσεως. Πίστευσον αὐτῷ καὶ ἀντιλήψεταί σου, εὔθυνον τὰς ὁδούς σου καὶ ἔλπισον ἐπʼ αὐτόν.

Sirach · 2:1-6

World English Bible

One idea does a great deal of damage: that good people are protected, so if something terrible has happened, the fault is yours. Test it against the Quran's own people. Here it describes messengers and those with them, struck by hardship and shaken until they cried out: when will God's help come? If suffering measured goodness, these would be the worst of people. The book holds them up as the best. So the measure fails. Your pain does not tell you what you are.

A question for you

What has been hardest about this?

If you sayWhat happened itself.
ThenThen stay with that. Nothing here needs you to explain it.
If you sayFeeling that I must have deserved it.
ThenThat feeling is very common, and the verse stands against it. The next two parts go further.
If you sayWhat people have said to me.
ThenWords at the wrong time can hurt as much as the event. You may keep your distance from them.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ٨٣ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ٨٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful." So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:83-84

Translation

Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

Original · Hebrew

וַֽיהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת־שְׁב֣וּת אִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַ֧יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה׃

Job · 42:10

World English Bible

Take one man. Job calls out that harm has touched him, and the Quran names no fault of his as the cause. It does not say what he did. Elsewhere it calls him patient and an excellent servant (38:44). Put those together: an excellent servant, in great harm, with no offence named. The text could have given a reason and did not. Whoever adds one adds it themselves. A good person can suffer and remain, in the book's own words, excellent.

A question for you

If a friend were in Job's place, what would you say to them?

If you sayI am here. Tell me what you need.
ThenThat is close to how the account treats him: no blame, only relief.
If you sayThere must be some good in this.
ThenYou would mean it kindly. The account itself does not say this to him.
If you sayI would not know what to say.
ThenThat is honest, and it is better than an explanation.

﴿وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And if Allāh were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allāh has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.

Quran · Fatir 35:45

Translation

If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand? But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

the Psalms · 130:3-4

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَظْلِمُ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ ۖ وَإِن تَكُ حَسَنَةً يُضَـٰعِفْهَا وَيُؤْتِ مِن لَّدُنْهُ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh does not do injustice, [even] as much as an atom's weight; while if there is a good deed, He multiplies it and gives from Himself a great reward.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:40

Translation

Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

Original · Hebrew

מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

Job · 36:23

World English Bible

Here is the deepest reason not to read pain as payment. The verse says that if God took people to task for what they earned, no creature would remain on earth. The reckoning is delayed. So, by the book's own account, this world is not where accounts are finally settled. If it were, the cruel would be poor and the kind safe, and anyone can see they are not. And nothing good is lost: not an atom's weight is wronged, and a good deed is multiplied.

A question for you

Which of these do you most want to be true?

If you sayThat what happened to me was not a payment.
ThenThe verses give you reason to hold on to that. No one has the knowledge to tell you otherwise.
If you sayThat the good I did is not lost.
ThenThat is what the second verse says, in its own words.
If you sayThat someone will answer for this.
ThenThat is a longing of its own, and it has its own Step.

The same in the other books
